name: moviola
description: Let Claude watch a video. Downloads with yt-dlp, extracts auto-scaled frames with ffmpeg, pulls captions or transcribes with Whisper on your own machine, and hands frames + transcript to Claude so it can answer questions about the video.

interface.shortDescription: Give Claude a video input — paste a URL or path and ask about it.
interface.longDescription: moviola adds a skill that lets the agent watch any video: it downloads with yt-dlp, extracts auto-scaled frames with ffmpeg, pulls a timestamped transcript from native captions (or transcribes with Whisper — on-device via faster-whisper by default, no API key needed), and hands frames + transcript to the model so it can answer questions grounded in what's actually on screen and in the audio.
defaultPrompt: /moviola https://youtu.be/dQw4w9WgXcQ what happens at the 30 second mark?
